claim: Independent review of the actual type-prime mixed-jet supplier, including arbitrary torsion denominators in the dilation step.

audit_groups.name: integral_section_from_formal_expansion
audit_groups.reason: The selected finite coefficient minor in the existing saturated-expansion proof is a unit. The argument extends to a product of smooth elliptic curves: the special fibre is integral and its regular local ring injects into its completion. This also controls arbitrary C_p coefficients, without a finite-extension assumption on the section.

audit_groups.name: pullback_when_p_divides_M
audit_groups.reason: For Q=NM with N prime to p and Qt in the frame lattice, [Q] is an integral morphism. The point v=t/Q satisfies Q^2v=Qt in that lattice, and hence belongs to the theta kernel of [Q]^*L. The reduced lift has Q^2-th power equal to a lattice semicharacter scalar. Its vertical divisor is a multiple of the reduced integral special fibre; after its removal, the finite-order relation forces the remaining scalar to be a unit. This uses no inversion of Q, M, or the order of the lift.

audit_groups.name: exact_reduced_lift_and_trivializer
audit_groups.reason: Bannai-Kobayashi Lemma 2.7 and Proposition 2.8 retain both Hermitian exponential terms and give A_v(F(Qz))=(U_tF)(Qz) in the stated reduced convention. The pullback of the product even theta section remains a local trivializer at the closed origin. Its series is an integral unit under the forward [Q] substitution. Only the [N] substitution is inverted, using N in Z_p^times.

audit_groups.name: ordinary_period_and_original_frame
audit_groups.reason: The good invariant period is Omega with absolute value one; the lattice-coordinate period is omega=Omega/iota(delta_0), not assumed a unit. The expansion in omega*iota(delta_0*v) equals that in Omega*iota(v). Original directions are exactly the O_Cp-span of v with L_0 v contained in Lambda. StatementKer48-50 and CardTwoSidedQuotient569-590 identify the frameM columns with c_D(tau)e_(tau,i,j), and their bar-pi multiples with the scaled jet directions.

audit_groups.name: mixed_derivatives_without_factorial_loss
audit_groups.reason: Iterated (1+T_i)d/dT_i preserves integral formal series and evaluates to invariant derivatives, with Omega a unit. Constant direction changes have integral coefficients and preserve the bound by multilinearity. The original jet is the factorial-weighted Taylor coefficient, as authenticated in CardTwoSidedQuotient565-601; no factorial inverse is introduced.

audit_groups.name: original_indicator_and_full_dimension
audit_groups.reason: KernelIndexForm14-84 cancels the two original square-root-volume factors exactly into the inverse two-sided quotient cardinality. CardTwoSidedQuotient393-417 and KerHalf367-473 give the coprime-factor decomposition, p not dividing u, and the full p-primary quotient cardinality p^(f*a*b). LiftKill retains c-prime t_k in the original lattice. All phases are original norm-semicharacter or Heisenberg phases at rational lattice points and are roots of unity.

audit_groups.name: both_split_prime_branches
audit_groups.reason: When |bar-pi|=|p|, the M=pc-prime dilation bound is exactly compensated by the bar-pi scaling of every original direction. When |bar-pi|=1, the numerator kappa=bar-pi^2 has conjugate pi^2 in p^2 Z_p and meets GM14. A fixed auxiliary S prime to p is removed modulo p, producing only a lattice shift. W_a=exp(pi*i*Q(a))U_a differs by a root of unity because Q is rational on rational lattice points; the commutator phase with t_k is likewise a root of unity. The simultaneous measure norm remains at most one.

audit_groups.name: actual_arithmetic_application
audit_groups.reason: HostTie61-62 makes the elliptic ideal the unit ideal; the previous ordinary normalization therefore applies in the actual family. The actual type-prime consumer supplies p>=5, unramified split data, original integral direction frame and a unit determinant character. The ultrametric bound retains exactly |p|^(f*a*b). The original C1=1 consumer retains its independent size, pairing and chain-agreement requirements.

primary_source.scope: Section 1.3 establishes the reduced-translation conventions. Lemma2.7/Proposition2.8 establish the exact Mumford expression. Proposition2.15/Corollary2.16 supply only the earlier prime-to-p input; they are not used as an arbitrary-torsion theorem.

scope_limitations: This is a mathematical and source-contract review, not a Lean compilation or complete audit of all transitive source dependencies.
The established ordinary normalized family and its simultaneous measure law are retained inputs; targeted input passages were reviewed, not re-proved in full.
The review does not establish the more general arbitrary-elliptic-ideal source interface.
The global arithmetic model, remaining integral constructions and theta nonvanishing remain open.
The finite checks verify exact algebra and valuation bookkeeping; they do not by themselves prove line-bundle extension or the measure law.
